objectives.description: Explain the nature and sources of history and identify how historians gather evidence
Describe the early peoples and cultures of Nigeria including the Nok culture and its significance
Trace the origin and development of ancient Nigerian kingdoms (Benin Kingdom, Oyo Empire, Kanem-Bornu)
Describe the Hausa-Fulani city states and their political, social, and economic organisation
Explain the social and political organisation of Igbo, Yoruba, and other pre-colonial Nigerian societies
Describe migration and settlement patterns of major ethnic groups in Nigeria
Explain the Trans-Saharan trade and the Trans-Atlantic slave trade and their impact on Nigerian societies
Describe British penetration into Nigeria and the establishment of colonial administration
Compare indirect rule and direct rule as systems of colonial administration in Nigeria
Describe Nigerian resistance to colonial rule by groups including Benin, Ekumeku, Tiv, Igbo, and the Sokoto Caliphate
Explain the role of missionary and Western education in colonial Nigeria and its long-term effects
Describe the role of women in Nigerian history including Queen Amina, Funmilayo Ransome-Kuti, and Margaret Ekpo
Identify key nationalist leaders (Herbert Macaulay, Nnamdi Azikiwe, Obafemi Awolowo, Ahmadu Bello) and their contributions
Explain the role of the Nigerian press and trade unions in the independence struggle
Trace Nigeria's constitutional development from the Clifford Constitution to independence in 1960
Describe the formation of political parties in Nigeria and their roles in the road to independence
Explain the role of youth and student movements in promoting nationalism and democracy

subStrands.name: Military Rule, Democracy, and National Development

objectives.description: Describe the periods of military rule in Nigeria and the transitions to civilian government
Explain the causes, events, and consequences of the Nigerian Civil War (1967–1970)
Describe Nigeria's national development plans including Vision 2020 and the Economic Recovery and Growth Plan
Explain Nigeria's membership and role in international organisations (United Nations, African Union, ECOWAS)
Describe Nigeria's sports achievements and their contribution to national unity and international recognition
Explain the effects of corruption on national development and identify strategies for accountability
Describe Nigeria's cultural heritage and the importance of tourism to economic development
